**ACCEPT** — PR #6468, head `dc276a970`. The dev contradicted the routing suggestion, I checked the contradiction against the tree, and **the dev is right**.

### The falsifiable half was falsified — and the real defect is bigger than the card's

Triage's routing answer said to correct the `chart` claimant list and *keep the `calendar` half after re-confirming it*. The re-confirmation failed, and the failure is more interesting than the card:

| bare key | claimants measured on `origin/main` |
|---|---|
| `chart` | **one** — `plugin-charts/src/index.tsx:88` |
| `calendar` | **one** — `plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx:303` |

`packages/components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx:13` does register `'calendar'`, but with `namespace: 'ui'` **and `skipFallback: true`**, carrying an in-place comment saying why — so it is reachable as `ui:calendar` only and never contests the bare keyword. The outcome is settled at the registration site, not by import order.

So the comment's **opening claim** — "several packages register the same bare keyword" — is the part that was actually false, and it was false for *both* examples, not one. Correcting only the claimant list would have left a true-sounding sentence resting on a false premise. Rewriting to state the mechanism plus the measured fact that nothing in this list contests a key today, with both single claimants and each `skipFallback` reason named, is the right shape.

The workspace-wide control is what makes that a measurement rather than a pair of anecdotes: exactly one bare key is claimed by two distinct packages — `page-header` (`layout`, `components`) — it is not among the thirteen this file imports, and it is guarded at its call site by `registerPlaceholders`' `if (!ComponentRegistry.get(type))` at `packages/components/src/renderers/placeholders.tsx:126`. A static-derivation artifact, not a runtime collision. Correctly filed as nothing.

### Two errors of mine this card surfaced, both worth recording

**1. My declared file face was wrong.** The claim comment named `apps/site/app/components/SchemaThumbnail.tsx`. The comment being fixed lives in `apps/site/app/components/registerCatalogBlocks.ts`. My census found the file containing the *string* `registerCatalogBlocks` — the importer — and I took it for the file that *defines* it. Same directory, no overlap with any open PR, so nothing was harmed; the dev edited the right file and said so.

**2. I nearly reported a phantom line-drift.** Checking the `:88` citation, my grep `register.*['\"]chart['\"]` returned only `:75` and I was set to flag `:88` as drift. `:75` is a *different* registration — `view:chart`, `skipFallback: true`, "reached via `view:chart` only". `:88` is a second, **multi-line** `register(` call with the key on its own line, no `skipFallback`, and it is the one that claims the bare key. My pattern required the key on the same line as `register`.

That is the "pattern too literal" trap out of this seat's own catalogue, committed by me while auditing someone else for it. `deriveRegistryKeys` — the repo's own tool — saw both; a hand-rolled regex saw one. The lesson is not "grep harder", it is **prefer the repo's derivation tool over a regex whenever one exists**.

### The rest, verified

Comment-only: filtering the `apps/` diff for any line that is not a comment or blank returns nothing. Two files — one comment block (12 lines replacing 6) and one empty-frontmatter changeset. No derivation pin, no generated sentence, no new test, exactly as ruled.

Every `deriveRegistryKeys` read carried a **positive control in the same call** (`dashboard` 3, `report` 2, `ui:calendar` 1, `calendar-view` 2, `object-grid` 1) plus a known-absent key scoring 0 — so the zeroes for `plugin-dashboard`/`plugin-report` on `chart` are measurements, not an untested tool. The shape census beyond the symbol found no registration wearing a different helper name.

The `@object-ui/site` type-check's first run was `exit 2` with `TS2882` across workspace imports — correctly identified as the fresh-worktree unbuilt-`dist` false red rather than reported as a finding, and green after building the closure.

**Clause-②: no public surface change.** `git diff` restricted to every `**/src/index.ts(x)` returns 0 lines, and **0 files under `packages/` changed at all**.

Enqueue is held only on CI: 27 checks, **0 failed**, 1 pending (`Lint`).
